Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says accusations that he favors surrendering human control to AI are absurd.

Rivals accused Amodei of supporting a shift away from human agency. He pushed back against the claims, even as leading AI companies automate more of their own research and model development.

Should AI companies automate their own research, or should humans stay in charge?
